sub: Farhan 89, Maaz 50 as Pakistan chase 183 to lead
paragraphs: Rawalpindi mein pehle T20I mein Pakistan ne Sri Lanka ko **4 wickets** se hara diya aur series mein **1-0** ki bartari le li.
Sri Lanka ne **182 runs** banaye, Lahiru Udara ne 55 gendon par **91** ki shandaar innings kheli. Naseem Shah ne **3 wickets** liye.
Captain Sahibzada Farhan ne 53 gendon par **89 runs** banaye aur Player of the Match bane. Maaz Sadaqat ne sirf 29 gendon par **50** jor diye.
Pakistan ne hadaf **7 gendein** pehle hasil kiya. Doosra T20I **Itwaar** ko Rawalpindi mein hoga.
